name: 33417 · West Palm Bch, FL
findings: ZIP 33417 (West Palm Bch) has 84 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33417 (West Palm Bch) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33417 (West Palm Bch) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 73% of the typical level).
